function.name: reschedule_booking
function.description: Move an existing confirmed booking to a new time. Identify the booking by booking_id, or by phone plus the current date (yyyy-mm-dd). Re-validates the new slot and moves the calendar event.

phone.description: Caller's number, if the booking_id is unknown.

date.description: Current booking date as yyyy-mm-dd, used with phone to pick the booking.

new_start_datetime.description: The new slot from check_availability, eg 2026-11-05T10:00:00+11:00.
